title: UFOs seen cleaning up radiation at Fukushima and Chernobyl

tellings.quote: And in both cases, people see the UFOs come down and seemingly clean up the radiation.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, citing a researcher named Jensine Andresen, talks about two nuclear disasters: Chernobyl in Ukraine in 1986 and Fukushima in Japan in 2011. He says that in both cases people saw UFOs come down and seemingly clean up the radiation, which would mean something out there is stepping in when our nuclear mistakes get dangerous.
